This Application has been filed by the applicant for anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.382 of 2022,
registered at Kotwali, Roorkee, District Haridwar under Sections 120B, 420, 467 and Section 468 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Section 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 has been added during the investigation).
2.
As per the First Information Report dated 11.05.2022, the informant is the owner of the property in-question.
An unknown person has impersonated him and sold his property to one Anees (named accused) vide a registered sale-deed dated 18.09.2021.
The named co-accused Nafees and Christopher Khem Chand are witnesses to the said sale-deed.
3. Heard Mrs. Prabha Naithani, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate for the State.
4. Mrs. Prabha Naithani, Advocate, for the applicant submitted that the applicant is an innocent person.
He is not named in the First Information Report.

sentences.text: Mr. Tumul Nainwal, Assistant Government Advocate for the State has submitted on instruction that the name of the present applicant has come to light in the confessional statement of the co-accused.
He has sought three weeks' time to file objection to the anticipatory bail application.

7. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad-interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant-Irfan Ali, he shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicant shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and he shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicant shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.
8. List on 09.09.2025 for hearing on the anticipatory bail application.
___________________ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
